inputs.goal: hire a senior backend engineer who can own our payments service

define-role.intake.summary: Need to identify senior backend engineer candidate with payments service ownership experience. Focus on technical skills in payment processing, system design, and scalability. Prioritize candidates who have led payment infrastructure projects and understand compliance requirements.

define-role.generate.draft:
Senior Backend Engineer - Payments Service Owner

Responsibilities:
- Lead design and implementation of our payments service infrastructure
- Own end-to-end payment processing systems including transactions, fraud detection, and reconciliation
- Design scalable, secure payment solutions handling high-volume transactions
- Collaborate with security team to ensure PCI-DSS compliance and regulatory requirements
- Mentor junior engineers and lead technical discussions
- Troubleshoot complex payment issues and implement robust error handling

Requirements:
- 5+ years backend engineering experience with Java/Go/Rust
- Deep expertise in payment processing, transaction systems, and financial APIs
- Experience leading payments infrastructure projects from concept to production
- Strong understanding of security protocols, encryption, and compliance standards
- Proven track record in system design and scaling payment systems
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field

Preferred:
- Experience with Stripe, Adyen, or similar payment providers
- Knowledge of blockchain or cryptocurrency payments
- Background in fraud detection and risk management

Compensation: $150K-$200K base + equity + comprehensive benefits
